title: Teaches communication skills to de-escalate
content: This book is amazing. It teaches skills to de-escalate and mitigate miscommunication, misunderstandings and to give voice to our sweet peas who can't figure out how to express themselves. It's amazing.

title: More Really Good Advice from Harvey Karp, MD
content: The summary on ParentsDigest. com showed this book to be as succinct, insightful and easy to follow as his 'Happiest Baby on the Block'. I would refer it to friend and I will look for more good advice from this author.

title: Easy to read.
content: Great practical advice for most common behaviors.

title: Watch the DVD
content: As with both his books (Happiest Baby and Happiest Toddler), the text seemed very repetitive. Plus the techniques he teaches are best understood through observation. Check the dvd out from your local library. I have used his techniques on babies and toddlers and give him 5 stars for coming up with some very logical and useful tools.

title: helpful resource for parents
content:
A helpful tool for parents seeking effective strategies for dealing with their children. As a social worker I often suggest this book to clients who are looking for good parenting books.

Liana Lowenstein, MSW
Author of, ""Creative Interventions for Troubled Children and Youth""
